build_transformer_sentence_encoder: build a bidirectional transformer sentence encoder with configurable layers, embedding dim, and attention heads
run_transformer_sentence_encoder_forward: run the transformer sentence encoder forward pass on token tensors with optional segment labels and attention mask
init_bert_params: initialize BERT model weights using normal distribution for linear, embedding, and multihead attention layers
build_embedding_layer: build a token embedding layer with specified vocab size, embedding dimension, and padding index
build_transformer_sentence_encoder_layer: build a single transformer sentence encoder layer with configurable FFN dim, attention heads, and dropout
